/images/ceh/m09-06-trust-boundary-zh.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 850" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0906-f1-zh-m09-06-trust-boundary-zh-TW-title m0906-f1-zh-m09-06-trust-boundary-zh-TW-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"><title id="m0906-f1-zh-m09-06-trust-boundary-zh-TW-title">圖 1｜信任來源與執行邊界</title><desc id="m0906-f1-zh-m09-06-trust-boundary-zh-TW-desc">可疑訊息與獨立可信來源分開；需核對身分、特定要求與授權後才執行。</desc><defs><marker id="m0906-f1-zh-m09-06-trust-boundary-zh-TW-arrow" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" refX="7" refY="4" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L8,4 L0,8 Z" fill="#57758a" /></marker></defs><g font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif"><rect width="600" height="850" rx="22" fill="#f6f9fb" /><text x="30" y="43" text-anchor="start" font-size="26" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">圖 1｜信任來源與執行邊界</text><rect x="30" y="77" width="540" height="116" rx="16" fill="#fff0d5" stroke="#b8cbd6" stroke-width="1.5" /><text x="50" y="111" text-anchor="start" font-size="24" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">未驗證的要求</text><text x="50" y="147" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">照片、聲音、網址、回撥號碼</text><text x="50" y="177" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">都可能由同一來源安排</text><text x="300" y="233" text-anchor="middle" font-size="22" fill="#914e27" font-weight="700">不能替自己作證</text><rect x="30" y="270" width="540" height="330" rx="16" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#87af9e" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="7 6" /><text x="50" y="308" text-anchor="start" font-size="24" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">獨立可信來源</text><text x="50" y="346" text-anchor="start" font-size="20" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">既有通訊錄／正式系統／既定核准流程</text><text x="50" y="375" text-anchor="start" font-size="20" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">不是可疑訊息新提供的聯絡資訊</text><rect x="55" y="404" width="490" height="77" rx="16" fill="#def1e8" stroke="#b8cbd6" stroke-width="1.5" /><text x="75" y="438" text-anchor="start" font-size="24" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">確認身分 + 這項要求 + 授權範圍</text><text x="55" y="524" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">三者有依據，才考慮執行</text><text x="55" y="554" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">仍須檢查目的地與必要資料範圍</text><path d="M300,602 L300,651" fill="none" stroke="#57758a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#m0906-f1-zh-m09-06-trust-boundary-zh-TW-arrow)" /><rect x="30" y="666" width="540" height="111" rx="16" fill="#def1e8" stroke="#b8cbd6" stroke-width="1.5" /><text x="50" y="700" text-anchor="start" font-size="24" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">受保護的行動</text><text x="50" y="736" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">付款／傳送資料／變更帳號</text><text x="50" y="766" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">無法核實 → 暫停、通報</text><text x="30" y="820" text-anchor="start" font-size="19" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">虛線＝查核區；箭頭＝通過查核後的流程</text></g></svg>
/images/ceh/m09-06-callback-zh.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 885" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0906-f2-zh-m09-06-callback-zh-TW-title m0906-f2-zh-m09-06-callback-zh-TW-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"><title id="m0906-f2-zh-m09-06-callback-zh-TW-title">圖 2｜回撥查核：換管道，也換來源</title><desc id="m0906-f2-zh-m09-06-callback-zh-TW-desc">依既有聯絡資料回撥，查證特定要求與核准；否認或不明時停止，而不是沿可疑訊息提供的號碼查證。</desc><defs><marker id="m0906-f2-zh-m09-06-callback-zh-TW-arrow" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" refX="7" refY="4" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L8,4 L0,8 Z" fill="#57758a" /></marker></defs><g font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif"><rect width="600" height="885" rx="22" fill="#f6f9fb" /><text x="30" y="43" text-anchor="start" font-size="26" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">圖 2｜回撥查核：換管道，也換來源</text><rect x="30" y="78" width="245" height="57" rx="16" fill="#dfeff9" stroke="#b8cbd6" stroke-width="1.5" /><text x="152" y="114" text-anchor="middle" font-size="24" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">接收者</text><rect x="325" y="78" width="245" height="57" rx="16" fill="#def1e8" stroke="#b8cbd6" stroke-width="1.5" /><text x="447" y="114" text-anchor="middle" font-size="24" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">既有可信聯絡人</text><path d="M152,145V748 M447,145V748" stroke="#b7cad5" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 6" /><rect x="35" y="165" width="530" height="100" rx="16" fill="#fff0d5" stroke="#b8cbd6" stroke-width="1.5" /><text x="55" y="199" text-anchor="start" font-size="24" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">① 暫停敏感動作</text><text x="55" y="235" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">不回撥訊息附的新號碼</text><text x="300" y="309" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">② 用既有通訊錄號碼回撥</text><path d="M152,331 L447,331" fill="none" stroke="#57758a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#m0906-f2-zh-m09-06-callback-zh-TW-arrow)" /><text x="300" y="379" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">③ 詢問特定要求與目的地</text><path d="M152,401 L447,401" fill="none" stroke="#57758a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#m0906-f2-zh-m09-06-callback-zh-TW-arrow)" /><text x="300" y="449" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">④ 接收回覆，另核對正式核准</text><path d="M447,471 L152,471" fill="none" stroke="#57758a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#m0906-f2-zh-m09-06-callback-zh-TW-arrow)" /><rect x="35" y="516" width="530" height="100" rx="16" fill="#fbe3e3" stroke="#b8cbd6" stroke-width="1.5" /><text x="55" y="550" text-anchor="start" font-size="24" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">否認／不明／無核准</text><text x="55" y="586" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">暫停 + 保存訊息 + 通報</text><rect x="35" y="645" width="530" height="100" rx="16" fill="#def1e8" stroke="#b8cbd6" stroke-width="1.5" /><text x="55" y="679" text-anchor="start" font-size="24" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">身分、要求、授權均核實</text><text x="55" y="715" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">僅執行核准的必要範圍</text><text x="30" y="789" text-anchor="start" font-size="19" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">箭頭＝通訊方向</text><text x="30" y="817" text-anchor="start" font-size="19" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">兩種結果不是連續步驟</text><text x="30" y="845" text-anchor="start" font-size="19" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">熟悉的聲音不是單獨充分的證據</text></g></svg>
/images/ceh/m09-06-controls-zh.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 865" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0906-f3-zh-m09-06-controls-zh-TW-title m0906-f3-zh-m09-06-controls-zh-TW-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"><title id="m0906-f3-zh-m09-06-controls-zh-TW-title">圖 3｜不同控制，保護不同關卡</title><desc id="m0906-f3-zh-m09-06-controls-zh-TW-desc">五組互補控制各自保護不同關卡，沒有單一控制能保證訊息內容或行動安全。</desc><defs><marker id="m0906-f3-zh-m09-06-controls-zh-TW-arrow" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" refX="7" refY="4" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L8,4 L0,8 Z" fill="#57758a" /></marker></defs><g font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif"><rect width="600" height="865" rx="22" fill="#f6f9fb" /><text x="30" y="43" text-anchor="start" font-size="26" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">圖 3｜不同控制，保護不同關卡</text><text x="30" y="83" text-anchor="start" font-size="19" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">互補控制，不是「每封信都依序通過」的保證</text><rect x="48" y="110" width="522" height="112" rx="16" fill="#dfeff9" stroke="#b8cbd6" stroke-width="1.5" /><text x="68" y="144" text-anchor="start" font-size="24" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">郵件來源</text><text x="68" y="180" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">SPF／DKIM／DMARC</text><text x="68" y="210" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">不是內容安全保證</text><text x="25" y="172" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">1</text><rect x="48" y="242" width="522" height="112" rx="16" fill="#def1e8" stroke="#b8cbd6" stroke-width="1.5" /><text x="68" y="276" text-anchor="start" font-size="24" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">訊息與端點</text><text x="68" y="312" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">過濾、連結檢查、端點防護</text><text x="68" y="342" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">仍可能有漏報</text><text x="25" y="304" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">2</text><rect x="48" y="374" width="522" height="112" rx="16" fill="#dfeff9" stroke="#b8cbd6" stroke-width="1.5" /><text x="68" y="408" text-anchor="start" font-size="24" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">人的工作流程</text><text x="68" y="444" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">獨立查證 + 特定行動核准</text><text x="68" y="474" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">不是只認聲音或頭像</text><text x="25" y="436" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">3</text><rect x="48" y="506" width="522" height="112" rx="16" fill="#def1e8" stroke="#b8cbd6" stroke-width="1.5" /><text x="68" y="540" text-anchor="start" font-size="24" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">登入驗證</text><text x="68" y="576" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">抗釣魚 WebAuthn／FIDO2</text><text x="68" y="606" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">綁定網站；不替交易授權</text><text x="25" y="568" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">4</text><rect x="48" y="638" width="522" height="112" rx="16" fill="#dfeff9" stroke="#b8cbd6" stroke-width="1.5" /><text x="68" y="672" text-anchor="start" font-size="24" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">影響與應變</text><text x="68" y="708" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">最小權限、通報、撤銷存取</text><text x="68" y="738" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">限制損害，保留證據</text><text x="25" y="700" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">5</text><text x="30" y="800" text-anchor="start" font-size="19" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">DMARC 通過：對齊的 SPF 或 DKIM 通過</text><text x="30" y="828" text-anchor="start" font-size="19" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">多層都要有涵蓋率、設定與紀錄可查</text></g></svg>
/images/ceh/m09-06-evidence-zh.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 903" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0906-f4-zh-m09-06-evidence-zh-TW-title m0906-f4-zh-m09-06-evidence-zh-TW-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"><title id="m0906-f4-zh-m09-06-evidence-zh-TW-title">圖 4｜看到什麼，才能推論什麼？</title><desc id="m0906-f4-zh-m09-06-evidence-zh-TW-desc">DMARC通過、MFA登入成功與沒有告警各自都有有限的證明範圍；後續查證補足內容、授權與涵蓋率。</desc><defs><marker id="m0906-f4-zh-m09-06-evidence-zh-TW-arrow" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" refX="7" refY="4" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L8,4 L0,8 Z" fill="#57758a" /></marker></defs><g font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif"><rect width="600" height="903" rx="22" fill="#f6f9fb" /><text x="30" y="43" text-anchor="start" font-size="26" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">圖 4｜看到什麼，才能推論什麼？</text><text x="30" y="85" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">先界定證據，再補查，不把訊號當結論</text><rect x="30" y="117" width="540" height="100" rx="16" fill="#dfeff9" stroke="#b8cbd6" stroke-width="1.5" /><text x="50" y="151" text-anchor="start" font-size="24" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">DMARC 通過</text><text x="50" y="187" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">網域驗證條件成立</text><path d="M55,222 L55,258" fill="none" stroke="#57758a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#m0906-f4-zh-m09-06-evidence-zh-TW-arrow)" /><text x="80" y="258" text-anchor="start" font-size="23" fill="#a44043" font-weight="700">≠ 內容安全／本人提出</text><text x="80" y="297" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">補查：查身分、要求與授權</text><rect x="30" y="343" width="540" height="100" rx="16" fill="#dfeff9" stroke="#b8cbd6" stroke-width="1.5" /><text x="50" y="377" text-anchor="start" font-size="24" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">MFA 登入成功</text><text x="50" y="413" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">登入驗證已通過</text><path d="M55,448 L55,484" fill="none" stroke="#57758a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#m0906-f4-zh-m09-06-evidence-zh-TW-arrow)" /><text x="80" y="484" text-anchor="start" font-size="23" fill="#a44043" font-weight="700">≠ 這筆轉帳已獲核准</text><text x="80" y="523" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">補查：查交易核准與工作階段</text><rect x="30" y="569" width="540" height="100" rx="16" fill="#dfeff9" stroke="#b8cbd6" stroke-width="1.5" /><text x="50" y="603" text-anchor="start" font-size="24" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">沒有收到告警</text><text x="50" y="639" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">目前未觀測到告警</text><path d="M55,674 L55,710" fill="none" stroke="#57758a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#m0906-f4-zh-m09-06-evidence-zh-TW-arrow)" /><text x="80" y="710" text-anchor="start" font-size="23" fill="#a44043" font-weight="700">≠ 完全沒有攻擊</text><text x="80" y="749" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="400">補查：查涵蓋率、規則與紀錄</text><rect x="30" y="810" width="540" height="63" rx="16" fill="#def1e8" stroke="#b8cbd6" stroke-width="1.5" /><text x="300" y="849" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" fill="#172e40" font-weight="700">證據範圍 ≠ 信心感受 ≠ 最終歸因</text></g></svg>
